name: Today, ___, which have brought a lot of harms in our daily life. First, ___ Second, ___. What makes things worse is that ___.
trans: 现在,……，它们给我们的日常生活带来了许多危害。首先,……，其次,……，更为糟糕的是…

name: Nowadays, it is common to ___. Many people like ___ because ___. Besides, ___.
trans: 现在，……很普遍，许多人喜欢……，因为……，另外(而且)……

name: Everything has two sides and ___ is not an exception, it has both advantages and disadvantages.
trans: 任何事物都是有两面性，……也不例外。它既有有利的一面，也有不利的一面

name: People's opinions about ___ vary from person to person. Some people say that ___. To them, ___.
trans: 关于……人们的观点各不相同，一些人认为(说)……，在他们看来，……

name: Man is now facing a big problem ___ which is becoming more and more serious.
trans: 人类正面临着一个严重的问题……，这个问题变得越来越严重。

name: Many people insist that...
trans: 很多人(坚持)认为……

name: With the development of science and technology, more and more people believe that...
trans: 随着科技的发展,越来越多的人认为……

name: A lot of people seem to think that...
trans: 很多人似乎认为……

name: There are different opinions among people as to ___. Some people suggest that ___.
trans: 关于……人们有不同的观点。一些人认为……

name: There is an old saying ___. It is the experience of our forefathers. However, it is correct in many cases even today.
trans: 俗话说(常言道)……，它是我们前辈的经历，但是，即使在今天，它在许多场合仍然适用。

name: But I don't think it is a very good way to solve ___. For example, ___. Worst of all, ___.
trans: 但是，我认为这不是解决……的好方法，比如……。最糟糕的是……

name: ___ is necessary and important to our country's development and construction. First___. What's more, ___. Most important of all, ___.
trans: ……对我们国家的发展和建设是必不可少的，(也是)非常重要的。首先，……。而且……，最重要的是……

name: There are several measures for us to adopt. First, we can ___.
trans: 有几个可供我们采纳的方法。首先，我们可以……

name: Confronted with ___, we should take a series of effective measures to ___. For one thing, ___ For another, ___.
trans: 面临……，我们应该采取一系列行之有效的方法来……。一方面……，另一方面，……

name: It is high time that something was done about it. For example, ___. In addition, ___. All these measures will certainly ___.
trans: 早就应该拿出行动了。比如说……，另外……。所有这些方法肯定会……

name: ___ has become a hot topic among people, especially among the young and heated debates are right on their way.
trans: ……已成为人的关注的热门话题，特别是在年青人当中，将引发激烈的辩论。

name: ___ has been playing an increasingly important role in our day-to-day life. it has brought us a lot of benefits but has created some serious problems as well.
trans: ……在我们的日常生活中起着越来越重要的作用，它给我们带来了许多好处，但同时也引发一些严重的问题。

name: According to the figure/number/statistics/percentages in the /chart/bar graph/line/graph, it can be seen that ___ while. Obviously, ___, but why?
trans: 根据图表/数字/统计数字/表格中的百分比/图表/条形图/成形图可以看出……。很显然……，但是为什么呢？

name: On the contrary, there are some people in favor of ___. At the same time, they say ___.
trans: 相反，有一些人赞成……，他们相信……，而且，他们认为……

name: In my opinion, I think it necessary to ___. The reasons are as follows. First ___. Second ___. Last but not least, ___.
trans: 对我来说，我认为有必要……。原因如下：第一，……；第二，……；最后……但同样重要的是……

name: Why ___? The first reason is that ___. The second reason is ___. The third is ___. For all this, the main cause of ___ due to ___.
trans: 为什么……？第一个原因是……；第二个原因是……；第三个原因是……。总的来说，……的主要原因是由于……

name: However, just like everything has both its good and bad sides, ___ also has its own disadvantages, such as ___.
trans: 然而，正如任何事物都有好坏两个方面一样，……也有它的不利的一面，象……

name: Nonetheless, I believe that ___ is more advantageous.
trans: 尽管如此，我相信……更有利

name: I fully agree with the statement that ___ because ___.
trans: 完全同意……这种观点(陈述)，主要理由如下

name: As far as I am concerned, I agree with the latter opinion to some extent. I think that ___.
trans: 至于我，在某种程度上我同意后面的观点，我认为……

name: In a word, the whole society should pay close attention to the problem of ___. Only in this way can ___ in the future.
trans: 总而言之，整个社会应该密切关注...这个问题。只有这样，我们才能在将来……

name: But ___ and ___ have their own advantages. For example, ___, while ___. Comparing this with that, however, I prefer to ___.
trans: 但是，……和……都有它们各自的优势(好处)。例如，……，而……。然而，把这两者相比较，我更倾向于(喜欢)……

name: Personally, I believe that ___. Consequently, I'm confident that a bright future is awaiting us because ___.
trans: 就我个人而言，我相信……，因此，我坚信美好的未来正等着我们。因为……

name: With the development of society, ___. So it's urgent and necessary to ___. If every member is willing to contribute himself to the society, it will be better and better.
trans: 随着社会的发展，……。因此，迫切需要……。如果每个人都愿为社会贡献自己的一份力量，这个社会将要变得越来越好。

name: For my part, I think it reasonable to ___. Only in this way can you ___.
trans: 至于我(对我来说，就我而言)，我认为……更合理。只有这样，我们才能……

name: There is no royal road to learning.
trans: 书山有路勤为径，学海无涯苦作舟。

name: Penny wise, pound foolish.
trans: 贪小便宜吃大亏。

name: A friend is easier lost than found.
trans: 得朋友难，失朋友易。

name: No way is impossible to courage.
trans: 勇者无惧。

name: The money the miser hoards will do him no good.
trans: 守财奴积财，对自己毫无好处。

name: Success belongs to the persevering.
trans: 坚持就是胜利。

name: A close mouth catches no flies.
trans: 病从口入。

name: The finest diamond must be cut.
trans: 玉不琢，不成器。

name: Adversity makes a man wise, not rich.
trans: 逆境出人才。
